title: AER Serverless P2P Market Order Schema
description: Cryptographically signed order manifest for decentralized P2P trading of GPU compute, proprietary MCP tools, and domain datasets (AER Appendix B).

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the schema specification (e.g. 1.0.0).

order_id.description: Unique 32-byte hash identifying this trade order manifest.

side.description: Order direction: BID (buyer offering Credit B) or ASK (seller offering resource).

resource_type.description: Category of computational, algorithmic, or informational asset being exchanged.

resource_specification.description: Structured metadata describing hardware capability, tool interface, or dataset schema.

resource_cid.description: Content Identifier (IPFS CIDv1, Swarm hash, or SHA-256 URI) pointing to the encrypted payload or OpenAPI/MCP spec.

quantity.description: Numeric volume of units (e.g. GPU-hours, API call credits, dataset chunks).

price_credit_b.description: Price per single unit denominated in atomic Credit B units.

total_price_credit_b.description: Total consideration in atomic Credit B units (quantity * price_credit_b).

maker_node_id.description: Ethereum address of the order creator broadcasting into GossipSub.

expiration_timestamp.description: Unix timestamp after which this order expires and becomes void.

nonce.description: Maker sequence counter to prevent order replay.

maker_signature.description: 65-byte ECDSA signature generated by the maker over the order payload.
